title: 杂诗
author: 沈佺期
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【杂诗】唐代沈佺期所作的诗。
tr: 逢著平樂兒，論交鞍馬前。與酤一斗酒，恰用十千錢。後余在關內，作事多迍邅。何肯相救援，徒聞寶劒篇。

en_body: I chanced upon a roisterer by Pingle Lodge,
and struck up friendship before his horse and saddle.
I bought for him a dipper of fine wine,
which cost me exactly ten thousand coins.
Later I stayed within the Pass,
and all my ventures met with thwart and woe.
Yet he would not lift a hand to come to my aid;
in vain I had heard him chant the Sword Song's gallant vow.

baihua_lines: 路上遇见一个在平乐观一带游荡的富家子弟，
就在鞍马之前与他结交为友。
我为他买了一斗酒，
正好花了十千钱。
后来我留在关中，
做事屡屡受挫，坎坷不顺。
他哪里肯出手相助救援我，
我只是空听过他吟诵宝剑篇的豪言罢了。
baihua: 逢著平乐儿，论交鞍马前。与酤一斗酒，恰用十千钱。后余在关内，作事多迍邅。何肯相救援，徒闻宝劒篇。

which cost me exactly ten thousand coins.
Later I stayed within the Pass,
and all my ventures met with thwart and woe.
Yet he would not lift a hand to come to my aid;
in vain I had heard him chant the Sword Song's gallant vow.

title: 独不见
author: 沈佺期
note: 《独不见》是沈佺期的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【独不见】唐代沈佺期所作的诗。

en_body: Since dust of war arose beyond the Jade Gate,
the young man marched to battle and never returned.
Dust settles thick where music pavilions once stood,
incense grows cold on the singing terrace by the stream.
Through the window the fading moon asks where he is,
the spring breeze lifts the curtain as swallows come back.
Ten thousand miles of silence, no word, no letter;
how can this small heart not crumble into ash?

baihua_lines: 自从玉门关一带战尘飞扬、战事又起，
年轻的丈夫从军远征，竟然再也没有回来。
家门外昔日演奏音乐的台榭早已积满尘埃，
水边那曾经按节拍歌舞的楼台香烬已冷。
窗前残月将落，不知心上人如今身在何方，
春风卷起珠帘，燕子又一次飞回旧巢。
万里之外一片寂寥，书信音信早已断绝，
一颗破碎的心又怎能忍住不化成灰烬呢？
baihua: 玉关一自有氛埃，年少从军竟未回。门外尘凝张乐榭，水边香灭按歌台。窗残夜月人何处，帘卷春风燕复来。万里寂寥音信绝，寸心争忍不成灰。

incense grows cold on the singing terrace by the stream.
Through the window the fading moon asks where he is,
the spring breeze lifts the curtain as swallows come back.

title: 利州南渡
author: 温庭筠
note: 《利州南渡》是温庭筠的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【利州南渡】唐代温庭筠所作的诗。

en_body: The empty waters lie serene beneath the slanting sun,
winding isles stretch dimly toward the blue-green hills.
A horse neighs on the waves as oars carry the boat away,
travelers rest by willows, waiting for the ferry's return.
From clumps of river grass a flock of gulls takes flight,
above ten thousand acres of paddy one egret soars.
Who knows to sail off in search of Fan Li the wise,
and on misty Five Lakes forget all worldly care?

baihua_lines: 空阔澄澈的江水映照着西斜的夕阳，
曲折的岛屿在苍茫暮色中连接着青翠的远山。
波面上传来战马嘶鸣，看着渡船摇桨远去，
柳树边行人歇下脚来，等待渡船归来。
几丛沙草之间，群鸥被惊得四散飞起，
万顷江田之上，一只白鹭正凌空翱翔。
谁能懂得乘一叶扁舟去追寻范蠡的足迹，
在五湖烟水之间忘怀世俗机心，飘然自适。

en_lines: The empty waters lie serene beneath the slanting sun,
winding isles stretch dimly toward the blue-green hills.
A horse neighs on the waves as oars carry the boat away,
travelers rest by willows, waiting for the ferry's return.
From clumps of river grass a flock of gulls takes flight,
above ten thousand acres of paddy one egret soars.
Who knows to sail off in search of Fan Li the wise,
and on misty Five Lakes forget all worldly care?

title: 瑶瑟怨
author: 温庭筠

en_body: Su Wu's soul dissolved before the Han envoy at last,
yet old shrine and tall trees now stand in blank unknowing.
By cloud-edge geese are cut off beneath the Tartar moon,
sheep return from Longshan as frontier grass smolders in dusk.
He came home to find the palace tents no longer his,
he had left with sword and cap in his prime, in the year of youth.
At Maoling no enfeoffment seal awaited him now;
he could only weep by autumn waves for time's swift flow.

如今古老的祠堂前高大的树木都已茫然无识。
云边大雁断绝于胡地天空的月色之下，
陇上牧羊归来，塞草笼罩在暮烟之中。
回朝之日，楼台宫殿已不是武帝时的甲帐模样，
离去时佩剑戴冠，正值壮年丁年。
茂陵长眠的武帝再也见不到他封侯的印信，
他只能空对着秋水，悲叹时光如流水般逝去。

author: 温庭筠

en_body: Yellow leaves drift down on the desolate garrison,
with noble heart you leave the old frontier post.
High winds sweep across the Hanyang ferry,
the rising sun lights up Mount Yingmen's crest.
How many old friends remain on the river?
A single boat comes home from the end of the earth.
When shall we meet again face to face?
A cup of wine to soothe the sorrow of parting.

baihua_lines: 荒凉的戍楼上黄叶纷纷飘落，
你满怀豪情地离开了故乡的关隘。
高爽的秋风从汉阳渡吹来，
初升的太阳照在郢门山上。
大江之上还有几个故人健在？
一叶孤舟将从天涯漂泊归来。
何时我们才能重新相见？
举一杯酒慰藉你离别后的容颜。

High winds sweep across the Hanyang ferry,

A single boat comes home from the end of the earth.

A cup of wine to soothe the sorrow of parting.

yet old in years, I have never won a noble rank.
Three thousand li away from my homeland,
my homeward heart yearns for her in the red-powdered bower.

author: 王勃

even at the world's end he is a next-door neighbor.
Do not at this crossroads of farewell
dampen your kerchief like a weeping child.

en_body: Three days married, she comes down to the kitchen,
washes her hands and sets to making broth.
Not yet knowing her mother-in-law's taste,
she asks her sister-in-law to try it first.
translation: 三日入厨下。洗手作羹汤。未谙姑食性。先遣小姑尝。
appreciation: 《新嫁娘》是唐代王建所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「三日入厨下。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，情景交融，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《新嫁娘》历代传诵不衰，是王建诗歌风格的集中体现。

title: 出塞
author: 王昌龄
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【出塞】唐代王昌龄所作的诗。
tr: 關山落葉秋，掩淚望營州。遼海雲沙暮，幽燕旌斾愁。戰餘能送陣，身老未封侯。去國三千里，歸心紅粉樓。

en_body: Leaves fall across the mountain passes in autumn,
I wipe my tears and gaze toward Yingzhou afar.
Clouds and sands darken over the Liao Sea at dusk,
in You and Yan the banners sway with grief.
After many battles I still can charge the line,
yet old in years, I have never won a noble rank.
Three thousand li away from my homeland,
my homeward heart yearns for her in the red-powdered bower.

我掩面含泪，遥望着营州的方向。

身已老去却始终未能封侯。

一颗思归的心牵挂着红楼中的妻子。

title: 同从弟南斋玩月忆山阴崔少府
author: 王昌龄
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【同从弟南斋玩月忆山阴崔少府】唐代王昌龄所作的诗。
tr: 高卧南斋时，开帷月初吐。清辉澹水木，演漾在窗户。冉冉几盈虚，澄澄变今古。美人清江畔，是夜越吟苦。千里共如何，微风吹兰杜。

en_body: Lying at ease within my southern study,
I draw the curtain and see the moon just rising.
Its clear light ripples over water and trees,
flickering and dancing on the window panes.
Slowly it waxes and wanes, time after time,
its limpid gaze seeing past and present change.
My fair friend stands by the clear river's shore,
tonight singing the songs of Yue in bitter longing.
A thousand li apart — what can we do?
The faint wind brings the scent of orchids and asarum.

baihua_lines: 我在南斋高枕而卧的时候，
掀开帷帐，看到月亮刚刚升起。
清辉洒在水面和树木上轻轻荡漾，
波光摇曳映在窗户之上。
月亮缓缓地圆了又缺，缺了又圆，
澄澈的月光照彻了古往今来的变迁。
我思念的美人在清江河畔，
今夜他一定在苦苦地越吟思乡。
千里相隔的我们又能如何呢？
唯有微风送来兰草和杜若的芬芳。

Yellow dust has filled that place from ancient times,
white bones lie tangled among the wild weeds.

contending with others for fame of artful smile.
The lord turned his heart away from his concubine,

The sun sets on the walls of Zhaoyang Palace,
autumn descends upon the long Changle Palace halls.
Desolate and empty within the golden chambers,
songs and music fall silent when night comes.

en_body: The traveler's road stretches beyond the green hills,
my boat glides forward on the emerald water.
The tide is full, making both shores seem endlessly wide,
the wind is true, a single sail hangs high.
From the night's last shadows the sea sun is born,
spring enters the river before the old year ends.
Where can I send a letter to my home?
Let the returning geese carry it to Luoyang's side.

title: 和贾至舍人早朝大明宫之作
author: 王维
note: 【和贾至舍人早朝大明宫之作】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: The red-capped cock-man calls the dawn watch tallies,
the keeper of robes brings forth the cloud-blue fur.
Ninefold palace gates swing open like heaven's doors,
envoys from ten thousand nations bow before the crown.
Sunlight first touches the immortal palm that catches dew,
incense drifts beside the dragon robe's coiling forms.
After court he must compose edicts on five-colored silk,
his jade pendants chiming as he returns to Phoenix Pool.

Mount Huang still curls past the Han palace halls.

not idly touring to feast on nature's splendor.

站在阁道上回望，上苑百花正盛。

author: 王维

en_body: After fresh rain in the empty mountains,
the evening air breathes of autumn's coming.
Bright moonbeams filter through the pine trees,
clear spring water flows over the stones.
Bamboo stirs — washerwomen are returning home,
lotus leaves shift — fishing boats glide downstream.
Let the spring fragrance fade as it will,
here in the hills a wanderer may stay.

baihua_lines: 空旷的山间刚刚下过一场新雨，
傍晚时分，天气透出阵阵秋意。
皎洁的月光从松林间洒落，
清澈的泉水在山石上淙淙流淌。
竹林中传来喧闹声，是洗衣女子归来了，
莲叶摇动，是渔船正顺流而下。
春日的芳菲就让它随意消歇吧，
山中的秋色自可让游子留居于此。
baihua: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。明月松间照，清泉石上流。竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。

author: 王维

my carriage and horses move slowly, at ease.
The running water seems to hold gentle thoughts,
evening birds return in company together.
A ruined city overlooks the ancient ford,
the setting sun floods all the autumn hills.
Far away at the foot of high Mount Song,
I shall come home and close my gate in peace.

车马从容不迫地缓缓前行。
流水悠悠仿佛怀有无限情意，
傍晚的归禽结伴相随还山。
荒凉的古城紧挨着古老渡口，
落日余晖洒满了秋山。
在遥远的嵩山之下，
归来后我将关上柴门，隐居于此。
baihua: 清川带长薄，车马去闲闲。流水如有意，暮禽相与还。荒城临古渡，落日满秋山。迢递嵩高下，归来且闭关。

the setting sun floods all the autumn hills.

title: 杂诗
author: 王维

en_body: We met at a corner of Luoyang city long ago,
when I broke a willow branch to send you on your way.
In all the state of Chu no woman matched my beauty,
yet I was a married woman from the land of Qin.
Before others I showed my jade wrists to pass the cup,
by candlelight I loosed my silk gown for my lord.
All who saw my husband riding from the east
said no other man could equal his bearing.
So I say to you, young captain of the guard,
take your jade winepot and trouble me no more.

title: 桃源行
author: 王维
note: 《桃源行》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【桃源行】唐代王维所作的诗。
tr: 漁舟逐水愛山春，兩岸桃花夾去津。坐看紅樹不知遠，行盡青溪不見人。山口潛行始隈隩，山開曠望旋平陸。遙看一處攢雲樹，近入千家散花竹。樵客初傳漢姓名，居人未改秦衣服。居人共住武陵源，還從物外起田園。月明松下房櫳靜，日出雲中雞犬喧。驚聞俗客爭來集，競引還家問都邑。平明閭巷埽花開，薄暮漁樵乘水入。初因避地去人間，及至成仙遂不還。峽裏誰知有人事，世中遙望空雲山。不疑靈境難聞見，塵心未盡思鄉縣。出洞無論隔山水，辭家終擬長游衍。自謂經過舊不迷，安知峰壑今來變。當時只記入山深，青溪幾曲到雲林。春來遍是桃花水，不辨仙源何處尋。

theme: 《桃源行》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代王维的代表性作品之一。
en_body: A fisherman's boat followed the stream, drawn by spring in the hills,
peach blossoms in full bloom lined the ancient ford on both banks.
Gazing at crimson trees he drifted farther and farther on,
until the green stream ended and no person could be seen.
From the mountain mouth he crept, at first through winding hollows,
then the hills opened and level land spread wide before him.
Far off he glimpsed a place where clouds and trees clustered thick,
closer on, a thousand homesteads scattered with flowers and bamboo.
The woodsman spoke for the first time names from the Han dynasty,
the dwellers still wore clothing from the time of Qin.
These people lived together at the Wuling source,
fields and gardens they had raised beyond the world of men.
In moonlight beneath the pines their windows were still and quiet,
at sunrise cocks crowed and dogs barked among the clouds.
Startled to hear of a worldly guest they gathered around,
competing to invite him home and ask of their old towns.
At dawn they swept the lanes where fallen blossoms lay,
at dusk fishermen and woodmen came home by the stream.
At first they fled the world to escape war and strife,
and having reached this immortal land they never returned.
Within the gorge who knew of the world of men?
From outside men gazed and saw only clouded hills.
The fisherman did not doubt this realm was hard to find,
yet worldly heart not spent, he longed for his home county.
Once outside the cave, though mountains and rivers barred the way,
he left his family at last, resolved to wander back.
He thought the road he'd traveled he would never lose,
not knowing peaks and valleys had altered in his absence.
He remembered only that he had entered deep in the hills,
following green stream bends to reach the clouded woods.
When spring came, peach-blossom flood was everywhere,
and he could not tell where the immortal source lay hidden.

baihua_lines: 渔船顺着溪水漂流，贪爱着山间的春色，
两岸的桃花夹着古津渡口盛开。
只顾看满树红花，不知不觉划了很远，
划到青溪尽头，竟然看不到一个人影。
从山口蹑足潜行，起初山路幽深曲折，
再往前山势开阔，眼前忽然现出平坦的陆地。
远远望去有一处地方云树聚簇，
走近才发现是散落着花竹的千户人家。
这里的樵客才第一次听说汉朝以来的姓名，
居民们还没有改掉秦朝时的衣着装束。
居民们都一同住在武陵源里，
在尘世之外建起了田园居所。
月明之夜松下的房栊分外寂静，
日出时分云中传来鸡鸣犬吠之声。
听说有俗世客人来了，大家都惊奇地聚集过来，
争相邀请到家中，问起故乡城邑的消息。
清早街巷里人们扫开落花出门劳作，
傍晚打鱼砍柴的人们乘船顺水归来。
当初他们为了躲避战乱才离开人间，
等到成了仙境便再也不回还。
这峡谷之中哪里知道人世间的事，
外面的人遥望这里只能看见空茫云山。
渔夫并不怀疑这仙境难以闻见，
只是尘心未尽，思念起故乡县城。
出洞之后无论隔着多少山水，
他终究还是辞别家人打算再次远游寻访。
自以为经过的旧路不会迷路，
哪里知道峰峦沟壑如今已经改变。
当时只记得进入山中很深，
青溪拐了几道弯才到达云林深处。
春天来了，遍地都是桃花汛水，
再也辨不清仙源该往何处寻觅。

title: 汉江临眺
author: 王维

Jingmen opens onto the nine river branches.
The river flows beyond the bounds of heaven and earth,
the mountain hues are seen and unseen between the haze.
Cities seem to float upon the forward reach,
waves heave and stir the far-off sky.
Xiangyang basks in fair wind and lovely weather,
let me stay and drink with old Master Shan.

title: 洛阳女儿行
author: 王维
note: 《洛阳女儿行》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【洛阳女儿行】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: A girl of Luoyang lives just across from my door,
her face still young — she can be little more than fifteen.
Her husband rides a dapple horse with jade-studded reins,
her maid bears sliced carp on a golden plate.
Painted towers and crimson pavilions face each other in rows,
red peach and green willow hang below the eaves.
Behind silk curtains she's led to a seven-fragrance coach,
jeweled fans welcome her home to a nine-flowered canopy.
Her wanton lord is rich and proud in his youth,
more arrogant in luxury than Shi Chong of old.
He dotes on his Jasper Girl, teaching her to dance himself,
and gives away coral trees without a second thought.
By the spring window the nine-flame lamp dies at dawn,
its petal-cinders fluttering like scattered flowers.
After play there is no time to practice a tune,
when dressed and painted she only sits by the incense.
All her acquaintances in the city are wealthy and grand,
day and night she visits the great mansions of Zhao and Li.
But who pities the Yue girl with a face like jade,
poor and humble, washing silk by the riverside alone?

baihua_lines: 洛阳有位女儿就住在我家对门，
看容颜才十五岁多一点的年纪。
丈夫骑着配有玉勒的青骢马，
侍女用金盘端上细切的鲤鱼脍。
画阁朱楼鳞次栉比，遥遥相望，
红桃绿柳的枝条垂向檐前。
罗帐之中被送上七香车，
宝扇遮面迎回九华帐中。
她的丈夫青春年少就富贵双全，
意气骄奢比石季伦还要奢侈。
他怜爱这位碧玉般的娇妻亲自教她跳舞，
甚至不惜将珊瑚树随手赠人。
春窗之前九微灯火到天亮才熄灭，
九微灯的片片落花般碎屑飞散。
嬉戏完了竟没有练习曲子的时间，
梳妆好了就只是坐着薰香。
城中相识的尽是繁华富贵人家，
日夜往来的都是赵、李那样的贵戚。
有谁怜爱那容颜如玉的越地浣纱女，
她出身贫贱，正在江头独自浣纱呢。

en_body: The slanting sun shines on the village hamlet,
along deep lanes the cattle and sheep are coming home.
An old man waits for his herdboy grandson,
leaning on his staff by the thornwood gate.
Pheasants call in the wheatfields where the grain is in ear,
silkworms sleep as mulberry leaves grow thin.
Plowmen return with hoes slung over their shoulders,
meeting each other they chat and linger long.
Seeing this, I envy the ease of country life,
and sighing, I chant the Shi Wei — homeward is my thought.

baihua_lines: 斜阳的余晖照在村庄之上，
深巷之中牛羊正纷纷归来。

惆怅地吟起《式微》，不禁生出归隐之志。

Late into the night she plucks her silver zither tenderly,
fearing the empty room, she cannot bear to return.

en_body: After long rain in the empty woods, cooking smoke rises late,
they steam goosefoot and cook millet, bearing meals to the eastern fields.
Across misty flooded paddies the white egrets fly,
in the shade of summer trees the orioles sing.
In mountain stillness I meditate on morning hibiscus blooms,
beneath pines I pick sun-mallow for my vegetarian meal.
I have cast aside all social forms like an old rustic,
why should the seagulls still mistrust me now?

蒸藜菜煮黍米，送到东边的田里给农人送饭。
广阔平坦的水田上白鹭翩翩飞过，
浓荫的夏木丛中黄鹂婉转啼鸣。

en_body: In the lands south of the Yangtze waters never freeze,
a warm breath flows secretly through hills and marshes.
In the twelfth month mountain birds can already be heard,
and on cold cliffs bears emerge from hibernation.
Willow groves are half-leafed as spring draws near,
reed shoots sprout in disarray before forming clumps.
Looking back toward the banks of Jinling,
I gaze northward, reluctant, into the northern wind.

依恋不舍地迎着北风北望。

en_body: In middle years I grew to love the Way,
in later life I made my home by Southern Mountain's edge.
When fancy strikes I often wander off alone,
and the joys I find are mine alone to know.
I walk until the stream runs to its end,
then sit and watch the clouds rise from the peaks.
By chance I meet an old woodsman in the forest,
we laugh and talk, and I forget to go back home.

晚年把家安在终南山边。
兴致来了常常独自出游，
其中的快意美事只有我自己知道。
有时走到流水的尽头，
便坐下来看白云从山间升起。
偶然遇到林中的老人，
就与他谈笑风生，忘了回家的时间。
baihua: 中岁颇好道，晚家南山陲。兴来每独往，胜事空自知。行到水穷处，坐看云起时。偶然值林叟，谈笑无还期。
en_lines: In middle years I grew to love the Way,
in later life I made my home by Southern Mountain's edge.
When fancy strikes I often wander off alone,
and the joys I find are mine alone to know.
I walk until the stream runs to its end,
then sit and watch the clouds rise from the peaks.
By chance I meet an old woodsman in the forest,
we laugh and talk, and I forget to go back home.

author: 王维

en_body: Taiyi Peak rises close to the Heavenly Capital,

a thousand valleys change between shadow and sun.
Seeking a place to spend the night among men,
I call across the water to a woodcutter for direction.

title: 老将行
author: 王维
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
tr: 少年十五二十時，步行奪得胡馬射。射殺中山白額虎，肯數鄴下黃鬚兒。一身轉戰三千里，一劒曾當百萬師。漢兵奮迅如霹靂，虜騎崩騰畏蒺藜。衞青不敗由天幸，李廣無功緣數奇。自從棄置便衰朽，世事磋跎成白首。昔時飛箭無全目，今日垂楊生左肘。路傍時賣故侯瓜，門前學種先生柳。蒼茫古木連窮巷，寥落寒山對虛牖。誓令疏勒出飛泉，不似潁川空使酒。賀蘭山下陣如雲，羽檄交馳日夕聞。節使三河募年少，詔書五道出將軍。試拂鐵衣如雪色，聊持寶劒動星文。願得燕弓射天將，恥令越甲鳴吳軍。莫嫌舊日雲中守，猶堪一戰取功勳。

en_body: When I was young, fifteen or twenty years old,
I could seize a Tartar horse on foot and shoot its rider.
I slew the white-browed tiger in the mountains,
never yielding to the yellow-whiskered brave of Ye.
Alone I fought across three thousand li of battles,
with one sword I once held back a million foes.
Han soldiers charged swift as lightning and thunder,
enemy horsemen scattered, spiked barriers feared.
Wei Qing won his victories through fortune's favor,
Li Guang gained no title — fate was unkind to him.
Since cast aside, I have withered and grown weak,
the years slip by; my hair has turned white.
Once my arrows could pierce a bird's eye mid-flight,
now my left arm is crippled as if by a weeping willow tumor.
By the roadside I sometimes sell melons like the Marquis of Dongling,
before my gate I plant five willows after Tao Qian.
Gray ancient trees lead to a lonely lane,
bleak cold hills face my empty window.
I vowed like Geng Gong to make Feiquan spring forth at Shule,
not like Guan Fu of Yingchuan venting rage in wine.
Beneath Helan Mountains the battle formations mass like clouds,
feathered dispatches race day and night without cease.
Commissioners levy youths from the Three River lands,
imperial edicts send five columns of generals forth.
I brush my iron armor until it shines like snow,
and grasp my sword whose blade bears star-like patterns.
I long for a Yan bow to shoot the enemy's generals,
shamed that Yue arms should draw near our Wu court.
Do not scorn the old governor of Yunzhong of former days;
he can still fight one more battle and win glory for his lord.

baihua_lines: 十五到二十岁的少年时代，
步行就能夺取胡人的战马射敌骑。
曾射杀过山中的白额猛虎，
武艺岂肯输给邺下的黄须儿曹彰。
一身转战南北，驰骋三千里，
一剑曾抵挡过敌军的百万雄师。
汉军奋迅出击如雷霆霹雳，
敌骑奔逃溃散，畏惧铁蒺藜。
卫青不败乃是由于天幸，
李广未能封侯只因命运数奇。
自从被弃置不用便日渐衰朽，
世事蹉跎，转眼已白发苍苍。
昔日飞箭术精，能射中小鸟一目，
如今久不习武，手臂上好像长了瘤子生了垂杨之疾。
路旁时而学东陵侯种瓜卖瓜，
门前学陶渊明种起了五柳。
苍茫的古树连接着偏僻的陋巷，
寥落的寒山对着空荡荡的窗牖。
发誓要像耿恭那样让疏勒城涌出飞泉，
绝不学颍川灌夫那样借酒使气。
贺兰山下战阵如云密布，
紧急军书日夜往来传送。
节度使从三河地区招募青年从军，
皇帝下诏派五路将军出师征讨。
老将拂拭铁甲，使之亮白如雪色，
姑且挥动宝剑，剑光闪动如星文。
愿得燕地良弓射杀敌国大将，
耻于让越甲兵逼近、惊动吴军朝廷。
莫嫌旧日云中守魏尚已老，
他仍能为国一战，建立功勋。

title: 西施咏
author: 王维

en_body: Great beauty is prized by all the world,
how could Xi Shi remain in low estate for long?
At dawn she was still a washer-girl by Yue Stream,
by evening she was a concubine in the Wu palace.
When poor, she seemed no different from the rest,
in her glory men saw how rare she truly was.
She bids maids apply her scented powder for her,
and never puts on her silk robes herself.
The king's favor makes her yet more winningly coy,
in his doting love all faults are overlooked.
Her old companions who once washed silk with her
may not ride home in the same carriage with her now.
I say to the girls next door who imitate her frown,
borrowed charm will never win a monarch's love.

傍晚就成了吴宫里的王妃。

尊贵起来才让人悟到她世间稀有。

君王的怜爱让她无是无非。

Above the ferry lingers the last of the sunset,

And here comes my friend, drunk like Jieyu of old,

渡头上还留着落日的余晖，

又遇上像接舆那样的醉汉裴迪，

author: 王维

Ancient trees — no human path among them,
deep in the mountains a bell rang — whence did it sound?

sunlight falls coldly upon green pine boughs.
At dusk by the bend of an empty pool,
in meditation I subdue the poison dragon of mind.

for several li I walked into cloudy peaks.

deep in the mountains a bell rang — whence did it sound?
The spring gurgles, choked by jagged rocks,
sunlight falls coldly upon green pine boughs.
At dusk by the bend of an empty pool,
in meditation I subdue the poison dragon of mind.

title: 送綦毋潜落第还乡
author: 王维
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【送綦毋潜落第还乡】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: In this sagely age none remains in seclusion,
all souls of worth have come to serve the throne.
Thus even the hermit of Eastern Mountain
could not remain at ease, gathering ferns to eat.
Having reached the capital, you found the palace gates far,
yet who shall say our cause is not just?
You passed Cold Food Festival by the Yangtze and Huai,
and sewed spring garments in the capital of Luoyang.
I set wine before you on the long road out,
my kindred spirit must now part from me.
Soon you will sail in your cinnamon-oared boat,
before long you will brush your own thornwood gate.
Distant trees seem to travel along with the departing guest,
a lonely village faces the last sunlight.
Our counsel merely chanced to go unheeded this time;
do not say that true friends who understand are few.

baihua_lines: 圣明的时代没有隐居不仕的人，
英才俊杰都来归顺朝廷。
于是便让像东山谢安那样的隐士，
不能再安心隐居、采薇而食了。
到了京城之后，才感觉君门遥远，
谁能说我们的道义不对呢？
在江淮之间度过了寒食佳节，
在京洛之地缝制起春天的衣衫。
在长安大道旁设下酒筵为你送行，
志同道合的友人就要与我分别了。
你将要乘着桂木船泛舟还乡，
不久就能回到家中拂拭荆扉。
远方的树影仿佛带着远行的客人，
孤独的村庄正对着落日余晖。
这次落第只是因为我们的谋划恰好不被采用，
不要以为知音稀少而沮丧。
baihua: 圣代无隐者，英灵尽来归。遂令东山客，不得顾采薇。既至君门远，孰云吾道非。江淮度寒食，京洛缝春衣。置酒临长道，同心与我违。行当浮桂櫂，未几拂荆扉。远树带行客，孤村当落晖。吾谋适不用，勿谓知音稀。
en_lines: In this sagely age none remains in seclusion,
all souls of worth have come to serve the throne.
Thus even the hermit of Eastern Mountain
could not remain at ease, gathering ferns to eat.
Having reached the capital, you found the palace gates far,
yet who shall say our cause is not just?
You passed Cold Food Festival by the Yangtze and Huai,
and sewed spring garments in the capital of Luoyang.
I set wine before you on the long road out,
my kindred spirit must now part from me.
Soon you will sail in your cinnamon-oared boat,
before long you will brush your own thornwood gate.
Distant trees seem to travel along with the departing guest,
a lonely village faces the last sunlight.
Our counsel merely chanced to go unheeded this time;
do not say that true friends who understand are few.

the ten thousand affairs no longer touch my heart.
I examine myself and find no grand strategy,
knowing only to return to my old woods.
Pine wind blows as I loosen my robe in ease,
the mountain moon shines as I play my lute.
You ask the truth of failure and success?
A fisherman's song drifts deep into the cove.

peach and plum cast deep shade, willow catkins fly.
Palace bells ring sparse as evening comes to the offices,
birds sing in the chancellery, clerks are few and far between.
At dawn your jade pendants sway as you hasten to the golden hall,
at dusk you bear imperial edicts, bowing at the palace gate.
I would gladly follow you, but age weighs heavily upon me,
and I must lay aside court robes to nurse my illness.

傍晚捧着天子诏书，拜别宫闱。

将要因病辞去官职，解下朝衣归隐。

en_body: Men say that Qingxi once had nine winding bends,
yet only one remains today.
By the Jiang family mansion it has become a flower garden,
before the Eastern Prefect's gate it is a vegetable plot.
Climb the tower and you may still gaze at layered peaks,
floating in a boat you may still drink wine in bliss.
I suppose in those days all was well and intact,
Tiaozha and Xiaoxiang themselves would not have surpassed it.

泛舟溪上仍然可以醉饮美酒。
想来当年这些地方都完好无恙，
苕霅、潇湘那样的胜景也不足称道了。
baihua: 人道青溪有九曲，如今一曲仅能存。江家宅畔成花圃，东府门前作菜园。登阁自堪观叠嶂，泛舟犹可醉芳樽。料应当日皆无恙，苕霅潇湘不足言。
en_lines: Men say that Qingxi once had nine winding bends,
yet only one remains today.
By the Jiang family mansion it has become a flower garden,
before the Eastern Prefect's gate it is a vegetable plot.
Climb the tower and you may still gaze at layered peaks,
floating in a boat you may still drink wine in bliss.
I suppose in those days all was well and intact,
Tiaozha and Xiaoxiang themselves would not have surpassed it.

title: 卖炭翁
author: 白居易
note: 《卖炭翁》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【卖炭翁】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 卖炭翁，伐薪烧炭南山中。满面尘灰烟火色，两鬓苍苍十指黑。卖炭得钱何所营，身上衣裳口中食。可怜身上衣正单，心忧炭贱愿天寒。夜来城外一尺雪，晓驾炭车辗冰辙。牛困人饥日已高，市南门外泥中歇。翩翩两骑来是谁？黄衣使者白衫儿。手把文书口称敕，回车叱牛牵向北。一车炭，千余斤，宫使驱将惜不得。半匹红纱一丈绫，系向牛头充炭值。

en_body: An old charcoal seller,
who cuts firewood and burns charcoal in the Southern Hills.
His face is covered with dust, the color of smoke and ash,
his temples streaked with gray, his ten fingers blackened through.
What does he do with the money from selling charcoal?
It buys the clothes upon his back and food to put in his mouth.
Pity him — in the thin clothes he wears,
he fears the charcoal price is low and hopes the cold will worsen.
A foot of snow fell outside the city overnight,
at dawn he drives his cart over frozen ruts.
The ox is tired, the man is hungry, the sun is high,
when he rests in the mud outside the south market gate.
Two riders come cantering up — who might they be?
Yellow-robed palace eunuchs and their white-shirted attendants.
Documents in hand, they declare it is the emperor's decree,
turn the cart about, shout at the ox, and lead it northward.
A cartload of charcoal,
more than a thousand catties in weight,
the palace men drive it off — he grieves but cannot stop them.
Half a bolt of red gauze and a bolt of thin damask,
tied to the ox's head, they claim is payment for the charcoal.

baihua_lines: 有位卖炭的老翁，
在终南山里砍柴烧炭。
满面灰尘，一脸被烟火熏烤的颜色，
两鬓头发斑白，十个手指都是乌黑的。
卖炭得来的钱用来做什么呢？
只是为了身上穿的衣裳和嘴里吃的食物。
可怜他身上正穿着单薄的衣衫，
却担心炭价太低，心里盼望天气再寒冷一些。
夜里城外下了一尺厚的大雪，
清晨他驾着炭车轧着冰冻的车辙赶路。
牛累了，人也饿了，太阳已经升得很高，
才在集市南门外的泥泞中歇息。
两个骑马翩翩而来的人是谁？
是穿黄衣的宫使和穿白衫的爪牙。
他们手里拿着文书，口称是皇帝的命令，
掉转车头，吆喝着牛，把车向北牵去。
一车炭，
有一千多斤重，
宫使们强行赶走，老翁百般不舍却也无可奈何。
他们把半匹红纱和一丈绫，
往牛头上一挂，就充当了炭的价钱。
baihua: 卖炭翁，伐薪烧炭南山中。满面尘灰烟火色，两鬓苍苍十指黑。卖炭得钱何所营，身上衣裳口中食。可怜身上衣正单，心忧炭贱愿天寒。夜来城外一尺雪，晓驾炭车辗冰辙。牛困人饥日已高，市南门外泥中歇。翩翩两骑来是谁？黄衣使者白衫儿。手把文书口称敕，回车叱牛牵向北。一车炭，千余斤，宫使驱将惜不得。半匹红纱一丈绫，系向牛头充炭值。
en_lines: An old charcoal seller,
who cuts firewood and burns charcoal in the Southern Hills.
His face is covered with dust, the color of smoke and ash,
his temples streaked with gray, his ten fingers blackened through.
What does he do with the money from selling charcoal?
It buys the clothes upon his back and food to put in his mouth.
Pity him — in the thin clothes he wears,
he fears the charcoal price is low and hopes the cold will worsen.
A foot of snow fell outside the city overnight,
at dawn he drives his cart over frozen ruts.
The ox is tired, the man is hungry, the sun is high,
when he rests in the mud outside the south market gate.
Two riders come cantering up — who might they be?
Yellow-robed palace eunuchs and their white-shirted attendants.
Documents in hand, they declare it is the emperor's decree,
turn the cart about, shout at the ox, and lead it northward.
One now here there still yet still.
more than a thousand catties in weight,
the palace men drive it off — he grieves but cannot stop them.
Half a bolt of red gauze and a bolt of thin damask,
tied to the ox's head, they claim is payment for the charcoal.

title: 后宫词
author: 白居易
note: 《后宫词》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【后宫词】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 淚濕羅巾夢不成，夜深前殿按歌聲。紅顏未老恩先斷，斜倚薰籠坐到明。
appr: 《后宫词》是唐代白居易所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「泪湿罗巾梦不成，」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《后宫词》历代传诵不衰，是白居易诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: Tears dampen her silk scarf — dreams will not come,
deep in the night, singing beats drift from the front hall.
Her rosy beauty has not faded yet favor is cut off already,
leaning on the incense cage she sits alone until dawn.

baihua_lines: 泪水打湿了罗巾，辗转难眠，连梦也做不成，
夜深了，前殿传来按着节拍歌唱的声音。
红颜尚未衰老，恩宠却已先断绝，
她斜倚着薰笼独自坐到天明。
